item.title: Running an Personal Assistant agent 24/7, that actually works - July 2026
item.description: Intro I started to use the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. They burn a lot of tokens for what they do, but they do get the job done. When I’m out of home, I can just message them or email them (cuz they manage their own email address, because i’ve created it for them), but they are good only based on the underlying model they are being used on. For example: torrent search and download, extensive research on a topic, using built-in search and integrations (since I already have skills for those), and even coding minor features with some guidance.
